This is my only plot, just under half a hectare, so I need to make it count for my family's maize. I'll try to use the FISP coupon if I can get it — that gives me a bag of NPK and a bag of urea, which is about right for my plot size. I'll plant hybrid seed if the coupon covers it, since the rains here in Mwanza can be uncertain and I want a better chance of yield. I'll do most of the work myself with my hoe — ridging, weeding, harvesting — but I might call a friend or two for ganyu during weeding when the grass is heavy.
